description: 21yo male, single-lead (Lead I raw + filtered duplicate, 20s @ 500Hz). Real clinical validation failure that drove ECG Core V1.1: original engine underdetected R-peaks (19 vs ~22 true), which inflated RR-CV/RMSSD enough to report 69% AF 'probability' despite 100% P-wave presence and confirmed sinus P-QRS association on clinical review. Has real manually-annotated R-peaks (.atr, symbol 'N') and T-wave markers (symbol 't') for the first ~9.8s.

clinical_reference.rhythm: sinus rhythm with prominent sinus arrhythmia
clinical_reference.note: insufficient lead information for reliable 12-lead STEMI/axis interpretation
